parameters.content:
## Fleet Maintenance Scheduler
Services each vehicle by kilometres or days, whichever comes first, and never takes too many off the road at once.

Each weekday it reads one row per vehicle (odometer, daily_km, and last service km/date for oil change, brake pads, tyre rotation, air filter). Items due within 14 days by kilometres or by time (whichever comes first) become work orders for the workshop; overdue items are flagged.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/fleet-maintenance-scheduler
